summary.text: J.D. Bernardy is the incumbent Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 36, in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia, which writes his name as J D Bernardy, lists his tenure in the House as beginning in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Bernardy lives in South Hampton, New Hampshire.
He served in the U.S. Navy and the U.S. Navy Reserve.
He earned a B.S. in biochemistry from the University of Minnesota, Twin Cities, and a J.D. from the University of New Hampshire.
His career experience includes working as a pharmaceutical consultant, and he has served as chairman of the South Hampton Zoning Board.
In the House he has served on the Science, Technology and Energy Committee, including as its clerk.
